_meta.note: Cute creature set for region 3, Revival Heights / Frostspire (Gary Oct 23 2026: 6 cute ones per region). All single-stage. Built by coder_cute_r3 (Oct 27 2026).
_meta.dex_no: PROVISIONAL numbers continuing after cute_r1 (454-459), until Gary/World Design slot them. DEX_450 itself is not edited; tools/sync_creatures.mjs reads design/cute_sets/cute_r*.json.

wild.why: Region 3 cute set lives in region 3 grass (Revival Heights trails, Frostspire Pass, Frostspire), mixed with existing spawns

creatures.name: Mufflynx
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy grey lynx kitten with dark spots, long ear tufts, big cream ruff and a dark-tipped tail. Crystal: small violet crystal on top of its head.

creatures.name: Mittling
creatures.habitat: Lost-mitten drifts along Revival Heights trails
creatures.visual_brief: Little spirit of a lost knitted mitten: red cable-knit body with a white snowflake band, cream fur cuff, pom-pom tail, a shy face peeking from the knit. Crystal: small violet crystal on top of its head.

creatures.name: Marmallow
creatures.habitat: Alpine meadows and burrows below Revival Heights
creatures.visual_brief: Chubby marmot pup with a mossy cape on its back sprouting edelweiss, buck teeth, rosy cheeks, dark flat tail. Crystal: small violet crystal on top of its head.

creatures.name: Snugworm
creatures.visual_brief: Woolly caterpillar in dark brown and ember-orange bands flecked with warm glowing specks, orange-tipped antennae, shy round face. Crystal: small violet crystal on its back.

creatures.name: Alpuff
creatures.visual_brief: Cloud-white baby alpaca cria with curly wool, pink-lined ears, dark hooves and a faint golden halo ring. Crystal: small violet crystal in its forelock.

creatures.name: Snowdrowse
creatures.visual_brief: Sleepy snow-globe spirit: pale-blue glass globe with drifting snow, a droopy pale-blue nightcap with a white pom, navy base. Crystal: small violet crystal set in its base.
